title: Unlocking the Antioxidant, Enzyme Inhibitory and Acaricidal Potential of Azadirachta indica Phytoconstituents Using In Vitro and In Silico Approaches.
authors: Fatima, Tehreem; Abbas, Mazhar; Zafar, Kinza; Zafar, Maha Gul; Haider, Waqas; Zafar, Muhammad Haseeb; Riaz, Muhammad; Iqbal, Munawar; Mtewa, Andrew G
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估印楝植物成分的杀螨活性，虽含分子对接但对象为酶抑制而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: The study evaluated the acaricidal potential of bioactive components of Azadirachta indica against scabies mortality using both in vitro and in silico approaches. Sarcoptes scabiei were stimulated with A. indica at four concentrations (25-100 mg/mL) at different intervals. The study assessed the cytotoxic, neuroactive, and detoxification-modulating potential of A. indica, emphasizing their antibacterial, antioxidant, and enzyme-inhibitory potential. LCMS was used for the characterization of phytoconstituents. In silico analysis encompassed target prediction, toxicity assessment, biological activity prediction, protein structure modeling, and gene expression analysis. Molecular docking assesses the binding affinities of bioactive components, and the ExPASy database predicts the physiochemical properties of glutathione transferase. In vitro analysis suggests that A. indica has a dose-dependent effect on S. scabiei at different time intervals. It highlights the extract's multifaceted bioactivity with strong antioxidant activity (IC(50) = 3.15 mg/mL) and potent antibacterial effects at higher concentrations. It exhibited mild to moderate hemolytic and significant AChE activity. Furthermore, it also showed GST inhibition, suggesting possible disruption of toxins. The binding affinity of 7-desacetyl-7-benzoylazadiradione showed significant inhibitory interaction with glutathione transferase (-12.324 kcal/mol). This phytoconstituent exhibited a high hyper-geometric p value; the total interactions between transcription factors, kinases, and intermediate proteins are observed. A. indica serves as a natural substitute for managing mite infestations and offering insights into mechanisms by which its phytochemicals show inhibitory effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用体外（in vitro）与计算机模拟（in silico）方法，评估了印楝（Azadirachta indica）生物活性成分对疥螨死亡率的杀螨潜力。在不同时间间隔下，以四种浓度（25-100 mg/mL）的印楝提取物刺激疥螨（Sarcoptes scabiei）。研究评估了印楝的细胞毒性、神经活性及解毒调节潜力，并重点考察了其抗菌、抗氧化和酶抑制潜力。采用液相色谱-质谱联用（LCMS）对植物成分进行表征。计算机模拟分析涵盖靶点预测、毒性评估、生物活性预测、蛋白质结构建模及基因表达分析。分子对接评估了生物活性成分的结合亲和力，ExPASy数据库预测了谷胱甘肽转移酶的理化性质。体外分析表明，印楝在不同时间间隔下对疥螨具有剂量依赖性效应。该提取物表现出多方面的生物活性，具有强抗氧化活性（IC(50) = 3.15 mg/mL）及高浓度下的强效抗菌作用。其表现出轻度至中度的溶血活性和显著的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）活性。此外，它还显示出谷胱甘肽转移酶（GST）抑制作用，提示可能干扰毒素。7-去乙酰基-7-苯甲酰基印楝二酮与谷胱甘肽转移酶的结合亲和力显示出显著的抑制性相互作用（-12.324 kcal/mol）。该植物成分表现出较高的超几何p值；观察到转录因子、激酶和中间蛋白之间的总相互作用。印楝可作为管理螨虫侵扰的天然替代品，并为其植物化学物质发挥抑制作用的机制提供见解。
